registry_role: Retrospective final-review claim registry. The contemporaneous commitment is experiments/source_lock.json.

claims.claim: If F is monic over O_K and F'=mH, every rational multiplier of a finite point fixed by F^n lies in m^n Z.
boundaries: the point at infinity is excluded
n need not be least period

claims.claim: The frozen PCF quadratic has no rational multiplier whose modulus is a rational prime at any period.
boundaries: does not exclude a nonrational complex multiplier of rational-prime modulus

claims.claim: Odd rational exponent-prime targets are excluded at every period; the target |lambda|=2^n remains open for n>=2.
Independent exact computations in conjugate coordinates agree through periods one to four and produce the four displayed cycle-multiplier polynomials with no rational roots.
boundaries: the finite cutoff audits implementation; the all-period inference comes only from C-THM-01

claims.claim: Matched controls recover the sharp powers of two, signed Chebyshev values, an odd prime multiplier when integrality is violated, and removal of a spurious formal-period factor.
The cotangent formula is exact symplectic on each regular branch and transports a regular zero-section return multiplier to a reciprocal pair, but is not a global symplectomorphism.
The exact audit used the source-locked period cutoff and no external prime or Riemann-zero data.
Only the parameter and motivation are inherited from Wang (2026); its prime-sieve claims and data are not reused or revalidated.
The raw rational-prime candidate fails its arithmetic entry gate, so cycle-determinant fitting, zero comparison, quantization, and Route B stop.
The critical orbit is exactly 0 -> 1 -> -(u-1) -> (u-1) -> (u-1), while postcritical finiteness is provenance rather than a hypothesis of the multiplier obstruction.
